programme.desc: An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

programme.title: Hands Across the Border
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

programme.title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
programme.desc: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

programme.title: Captain Apache
programme.desc: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

programme.title: Out of the Cage - Chris Smeltzer
programme.desc: Chris Smeltzer's journey into MMA began 12 years ago, through Karate. Chris' work as a School Bus driver fits perfectly with his MMA lifestyle, allowing him the flexibility to train throughout the day, as well run a karate school for kids. The martial artist lifestyle helped bring structure to all areas of Chris' life. He believes he has become a better person through Martial Arts, and he makes the mental distinction between between being a fighter and being Martial Artist. He prefers the standup game feels he is progressing well to being an all around fighter with his BJJ Blue Belt.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Kill the Wicked!
programme.desc: Good Samaritan drifter, Benny Hudson and a stranded woman, Jenny finds themselves being torture; when they accidentally walk into an gang's hideout in a ghost town.

programme.title: Apache Gold
programme.desc: The construction of the Great Western Railroad causes tension between settlers and Native American tribes. Criminal gang leader Santer seeks control of a gold mine on sacred Apache land and manipulates the railroad route through it. Old Shatterhand, working as a surveyor, uncovers the scheme and tries to warn the Apaches to prevent war.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django returns home to discover that his father has been killed by local bandits in a business deal gone wrong.

programme.title: Troublemakers
programme.desc: Two brothers who hate each other are going to spend Christmas with their mother. She tries to get them together.

programme.title: Sabata the Killer
programme.desc: Sabata and Mangosta are bank robbers, who after a bank job, through a series of events, end up teaming up with the bank clerk, Peter. They then go on the run with Peter's boss and a hired posse equipped with the latest technology in weapons on their trail.

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

programme.title: Return of Halleluja
programme.desc: In 1860s Mexico, General Ramirez hires American gunfighter Hallelujah to recover a stolen Aztec statue to win indigenous support. But a Scottish adventurer, feuding brothers, bandits, and the army are also in pursuit, turning the hunt into a chaotic race for power.

programme.title: Death Knows No Time
programme.desc: A poor Mexican farmer, evicted from his land, turns to banditry and ends up in prison. While he serves his sentence, his young son is adopted by a wealthy family. Once freed, he sets out to reclaim both his child and the $200,000 he hid after a bank robbery, facing a struggle between love and greed.

programme.title: One Dollar Too Many
programme.desc: Suave gambler Clay Watson, cocky sharpshooter Moses Lang, and wily thespian Edwin Kean are a trio of criminals in the Old West.

programme.title: Reverend's Colt
programme.desc: Reverend Miller arrives in Tucson where he wants to build a church, but on the very day of his arrival a gang raids the bank and the people of Tucson, suspicious of the new reverend because he is carrying a gun, immediately blame him for the robbery.

programme.title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
programme.desc: Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.

programme.title: Tepepa
programme.desc: In early 20th-century Mexico, the guerrilla leader Tepepa is saved from execution by Doctor Price, an Englishman. Tepepa, a hero of the Revolution, is curious about the doctor’s motives. The chilling answer: to kill him himself. A deadly game of cat and mouse begins between Tepepa and the ruthless police chief, Cascorro.

programme.title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
programme.desc: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a massacre in the North seeks revenge. After suffering the atrocity, the Kid executes a solo revenge, razes, beats and kills everyone involved in the massacre.

programme.title: Last of the Renegades
programme.desc: As settlers encroach on Native lands, the Assiniboins go to war while Apache chief Winnetou tries to maintain peace. A corrupt oilman, Bud Forrester, orchestrates attacks to provoke conflict and seize oil-rich territory. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou, and Lord Castlepool unite to expose the scheme and prevent a full-scale war.

programme.title: The Desperado Trail
programme.desc: After the Civil War, renegade Rollins and his gang stir conflict between settlers and Native Americans. Apache chief Winnetou and his friend Old Shatterhand try to preserve peace, but Winnetou is framed for the murder of Chief White Buffalo’s son using his own knife. Old Shatterhand must uncover the truth and clear his friend’s name.

programme.title: Treasure of Silver Lake
programme.desc: In Arkansas, a stagecoach robbery by Colonel Brinkley’s gang leaves one passenger dead and a treasure map split in two. His son Fred Engel joins Old Shatterhand and Winnetou to hunt the killers and recover the map. Their search leads them to a farm holding the second half—and to a race against Brinkley’s gang for the gold at Silver Lake.

programme.title: Winnetou and the Crossbreed
programme.desc: On her 21st birthday, Apanatschi inherits her father’s secret gold mine. When greedy prospectors discover its existence, they plot to seize it by targeting her family. Forced to seek Winnetou’s help, Apanatschi soon finds herself caught in a dangerous struggle involving outlaws, betrayal, and hidden treasure.

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Two outlaws, "The Doctor" and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

programme.title: Iguana
programme.desc: A mistreated, deformed sailor escapes his crew and crowns himself the ruthless king of an island.

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter. The noble squaw manages to escape, and hides out with a rough rancher, who dislikes Indians, but hates the Southerners more.

programme.title: Summer Love
programme.desc: In the world of fast cars and easy money, a race becomes a shortcut to betrayal and death.

programme.title: Murder Obsession
programme.desc: Michael Stanford, a promising young actor, suffers from the stress caused by his job. Fatigue creates large gaps in his memory and makes him unstable character-wise. Therefore, Michael decides to retreat to his mother's house, inviting the entire film crew as well.

programme.desc: An intimate apparel model gets entangled in a dangerous psychological game with two men.

programme.title: Ben and Charlie
programme.desc: The pair of small-time hustlers settle in a town with the intention of conning the locals out of their money. This time, however, the duo will end up outsmarting themselves.

programme.title: La soldatessa alle grandi manovre
programme.desc: A beautiful female doctor causes romantic chaos at an army base during training maneuvers.

programme.title: Palermo-Milan One Way
programme.desc: During an interrogation, turncoat Marinnà mentions the name of Turi Arcangelo Leofonte, nicknamed "the Mafia's accountant" because of his dealings with organized crime.

programme.title: Take Five
programme.desc: Five unlikely thieves are faced with the opportunity of a lifetime: a multi-million dollar robbery in a bank vault. programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.
